mechanism_and_repair.mechanism: MUI mouseover honors ignoreNonTouchEvents; mouseleave does not. Mouseleave and touchend share leaveTimer. A mouseleave can replace the1500ms touchend timeout with the default0ms hover-leave timeout.
mechanism_and_repair.repair: Completed click/tap sets explicit activation. While activated, disableHoverListener removes trigger and interactive-tooltip hover listeners so later compatibility mouseleave cannot replace the touch-leave timer. onClose also ignores a mouseleave already queued before activation committed. Other close callbacks reset activation and open state, restoring ordinary hover behavior.
mechanism_and_repair.timer_boundary: The queued-mouseleave guard retains visibility but cannot restore a touchend timer already replaced before listeners were suspended. The native observed post-activation sequence retains natural timeout dismissal; pre-commit timer replacement is not claimed universally impossible or restored.
mechanism_and_repair.preserved: Same MUI Tooltip, content, aria-labels, describeChild, enterTouchDelay0, stopPropagation on click/focus, styles and layout. Blur, Escape and MUI touchend dismissal remain active. No separate click-away listener or timer added.
mechanism_and_repair.desktop_click_semantics: Completed mouse or keyboard-generated click also activates retention; pure hover remains transient. Genuine dismissal restores hover listeners.
